name: blog
description: akiblog — static Astro blog (blog.akibh.dev). Posts are synced at build time from the notes repo (github.com/akibh-dev/notes), styled with the portfolio's design system, indexed by Pagefind, deployed to Cloudflare Pages. See plan/plan19-21.md.

scripts.build: bun scripts/sync-content.ts && astro build && pagefind --site dist
scripts.preview:pages: bun run build && wrangler pages dev --port 4332
